**Pull request #3489 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #3489: Patch: hovering your hand no longer redraws the whole board, and each card's face is built once per change instead of on every redraw

Closes #3478

## What changed

Hovering the viewer's hand no longer re-renders `Board`, and card faces are memoized per card:

- New [hoveredHandCard.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3478/apps/web/src/game/hoveredHandCard.tsx): `HoveredHandCardProvider` owning the `string | null` hover state, plus value/setter hooks with `null`/noop defaults so bare `Hand`/`Zone` mounts keep working.
- [faces.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3478/apps/web/src/game/faces.ts): new `useLiveFace(info, card, facts)` hook memoizing `liveFace` on the view object, `info.def`/`info.name`, the live facts (tallies keyed on contents), and the locale (R711000). `liveFace` itself is untouched.
- [Card.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3478/apps/web/src/game/Card.tsx) and [HandHints.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3478/apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx) call the hook with the same facts as before; `HandHints` drops its direct `useLocale` (the hook subscribes). No card looks any different.
- [Zone.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3478/apps/web/src/game/Zone.tsx) reads the hovered id and adds the counted set via `countedTestids`, passing it to `TileAura`/`Card`/`Backrow`.
- [Board.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3478/apps/web/src/game/Board.tsx): hover state, `counted`, and `fieldHighlight` deleted; field plus viewer's hand wrapped in the provider; plain `highlight` passed to zones.
- [Hand.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3478/apps/web/src/game/Hand.tsx): pointer handlers report to `props.onHover ?? contextHover`; `onHover` documented as a test override.
- [contract.ts](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3478/apps/web/src/game/contract.ts): one-line doc fix (`Zone.tsx` adds `counted`, not `Board.tsx`).
- New [Board.render.test.tsx](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-3478/apps/web/src/game/Board.render.test.tsx): the three acceptance tests, counting mocked `face` calls.

## How it was tested

- New file: 3/3 pass. Hovering all 4 hand cards enter+leave adds zero `face` calls, with rings appearing/clearing on the previewed card.
- Negative control: with the memo forced to always miss, the hover test fails 198 calls vs 38 baseline (8 hover events × ~20 faces — the issue's "twice per card" redraw, measured). Reverted after.
- Existing suites all green: `Board`, `Hand`, `HandHints`, `Card`, `Zone` tests — 122 tests across 6 files, including the four #991 ring tests.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, eslint on all touched files, `cargo fmt --check`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` (1871 rulings, 4834 proofs) all pass.

## Decisions and departures from the plan

- The viewer's `Seat` stands inside the hover provider with the field and hand: it sits between them in `board.css` grid order, consumes no hover state, and React skips re-rendering it on hover. Rejected moving it (would break grid order). Proof it stays still: piles recompute faces on every render, and the hover test shows zero new calls.
- `useLiveFace` accepts `CardView | null` (backs keep the placeholder without crossing) and `Zone` falls back to `NO_HIGHLIGHT` when spreading the counted set; the test mounts via `withCatalog` (which exposes `rerender`) instead of `renderBoard`. No `catalog.ts` change was needed.
- `viewFaces` has no definition or callers anywhere in `apps/web/src` or `e2e`, so there was nothing to delete. No ruling note: web-only change, no rules decision.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `muse`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 22.7 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 6s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 2s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 3s |

</details>
```

**Issue #3478 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #3478: Patch: hovering your hand no longer redraws the whole board, and each card's face is built once per change instead of on every redraw Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means When you slide the pointer across your hand, the game redraws the entire board twice for every card you cross. On each redraw, every card on screen asks the game engine to describe its face again, even though nothing about it changed. On a phone or a slow laptop that can stutter exactly while you read your hand. After this change, only what changes is redrawn, and a card's face is worked out once each time it actually changes. ## Why - `apps/web/src/game/Board.tsx:614` keeps the hovered hand card in the board's own state, and `Hand.tsx:160-161` sets it on every pointer enter and leave. The whole board re-renders twice per card crossed (#991's field rings, R583). - `game/Card.tsx:236` is not memoized and calls `liveFace` on every render (`:263`). `game/HandHints.tsx:36` calls it again for each hand card. - Each `liveFace` call (`game/faces.ts:55-66`) crosses into WebAssembly. `face()` in `wasm/index.ts` JSON-encodes the card with its whole definition, runs `jackioh-shared`'s face model and parses the answer. Nothing caches the result. - `viewFaces` (`faces.ts:72`), the batch call that builds every face a view shows in one crossing, has no caller. - #3351 just held the looks and animations to a phone budget (390x844, throttled CPU). This is the board's own render cost under the same conditions. Precedent: #2266 memoized the deck builder's cards and counts face calls in `game/deckbuilder/PoolGrid.render.test.tsx`. - This comes from reading the code, not from a measurement; the first criterion below measures it. ## Proposal - Memoize the face in `Card` and `HandHints`, keyed on the card's view object, its definition, the live facts (`fieldPower`, `copied`, `tallies`, whether it is in hand) and the locale (R711000). Alternatively, build one cache per view with `viewFaces` and read it from both. If `viewFaces` stays unused, delete it. - Take the hovered id out of `Board`'s own state and put it in a small context or store that only the field's ringed cards read. Alternatively, wrap `Hand`, the zones and `Card` in `memo` with stable props. Either way a hover should re-render the rings and nothing else. - No card looks any different. ## Where it lands `apps/web/src/game/Board.tsx`, `Card.tsx`, `HandHints.tsx`, `Hand.tsx`, `faces.ts` and tests beside them. SPEC §10's client rendering is unchanged. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] A render test in the style of `PoolGrid.render.test.tsx` mocks `wasm/index.ts`'s `face`, renders a `Board` with a full hand and field, and fires pointerenter and pointerleave across every hand card. The number of face calls does not grow with the hovers: there are no new calls for cards whose view did not change. - [ ] A new view that changes one card's stats recomputes that card's face, and a locale switch recomputes every face (tests). - [ ] The #991 and R583 field rings still appear on hover (the existing tests pass). - [ ] Every apps/web test, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and eslint pass. ## Size and risks Medium, web only, about 6 to 8 files. If a memo key misses an input (the locale, a fact from a hook), a card shows a stale face; the tests above pin each input. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty.
